findings.title: FRRouting BGP daemon denial of service
findings.solution: Upgrade the OPNsense FRR plugin to the fixed release.

findings.title: Weak SSL/TLS cipher suites accepted (RC4/3DES)
findings.solution: Disable RC4 and 3DES cipher suites; prefer TLS 1.2 or 1.3.

findings.title: OPNsense firmware is out of date: vendor security advisories not applied
findings.solution: Back up the configuration, then update FW01 to the current OPNsense release.

findings.title: Netlogon elevation of privilege (Zerologon)
findings.solution: Apply the August 2020 update and enforce secure channel.

findings.title: Windows TCP/IP IPv6 remote code execution
findings.solution: Apply the August 2024 cumulative update.

findings.title: Windows Support Diagnostic Tool remote code execution (Follina)
findings.solution: Apply the June 2022 update and disable the MSDT URL protocol.

findings.title: TLS/SSL weak cipher suite (SWEET32, 3DES)
findings.solution: Disable 3DES cipher suites and reissue the certificate.

findings.title: SMB signing is not required (relay and tampering risk)
findings.solution: Require SMB signing by Group Policy on servers and workstations.
